decisions: SleepingBeautyCandidate separates delayed recognition from ordinary dormant-paper detection and records awakening year, beauty period and citation evidence.
Citation-series detection requires an observed early window and a later citation peak above both an absolute threshold and an early-attention ratio; flat series are excluded.
Explicit sleeping-beauty text may produce a lower-confidence candidate with unknown citation counts; the detector does not invent missing metrics.
The detector has no hidden wall-clock date, network lookup or production side effect; structured time series are the authoritative quantitative input.
remaining_risks: The default early window is four years and the thresholds are heuristics, not a bibliometric standard.
Text extraction is English and cannot independently validate a delayed-recognition claim without a citation series.
limitations: No network, credentials, external dependencies, registry lookup or production write was used.
